surface.runtime_console_policy: These two external MathJax component metadata warnings are recorded transparently; no page-level reader warning or error occurred, and neither affected rendered math or layout.

viewports.name: desktop
viewports.visual_result: Centered, page-filling reader; title and contents hierarchy are legible with balanced margins.

viewports.name: tablet
viewports.visual_result: Centered responsive reader; all overflow remains inside explicit local formula/code surfaces, while wide tables remain contained by their wrappers.

viewports.name: mobile
viewports.visual_result: Readable narrow-column reflow with no page-level overflow; every wide equation has one focusable outer horizontal scroll surface and no nested scrollbar.

chart.alt: Grafik logaritmik kesenjangan objektif terhadap jumlah evaluasi gradien komponen untuk Proks-SGD, Proks-minibatch, dan Prox-SAGA; seluruh nilai tersedia dalam tabel data lengkap, CSV, dan JSON.

repair.problem: MathJax display containers inherited a second horizontal overflow rule inside the intended outer math-scroll wrapper.
repair.change: The generated CSS now assigns horizontal overflow only to the focusable outer math-scroll surface and forces the nested MathJax display container to overflow visibly.
repair.evidence: At 390 pixels, 30 formulas overflow locally, all 30 outer surfaces are keyboard-focusable, nested auto-scroll surfaces equal zero, and document scroll width equals client width.

limitations: The standalone HTML stores TeX and uses pinned external MathJax 3.2.2 at runtime; rendered browser state exposes 249 assistive MathML surfaces, while offline pre-render semantics are supplied by the EPUB instead.
The PDF remains an untagged fixed-layout companion; HTML and EPUB are the preferred reflow surfaces.
